class: SYNTHETIC renders + Zero-G lab images (per the dataset pages)
reason: Every SPARK release (2021, 2022, 2024, 2026) is distributed on request through a contact form ('To make a request for the data, please use the following contact form'); the SPARK 2022 Zenodo record 6599762 has access_right='restricted' and lists no public files. No request was submitted on the user's behalf (it needs the user's identity and acceptance of the providers' terms).
task_fit: resolved spacecraft detection / pose (11 classes, one 'debris' class); does not match the unresolved point-target study even if obtained. COSMOS already ships a converter: cosmos.debris.realimagery.convert_to_yolo.
how_to_obtain: submit the form at https://cvi2.uni.lu/spark-2022-dataset/, place the archives in data/feature2_debris/spark/raw/, then run cosmos.debris.realimagery.convert_to_yolo('spark')
